preconditions.description: Contract must be deployed and initialized with frozen=false or owner must call unfreezeTransfers()
Attacker must have some balance of the LineAxis token to test transfers

exploit_hint: The ERC20 approve() function incorrectly validates against the caller's balance instead of checking for overflow. Call approve() with a very large value (type(uint256).max) to set unlimited allowance for a spender. This violates ERC20 standard which should return true/false and properly handle overflow conditions. The exploit demonstrates the logic flaw by setting max allowance without proper validation.
